research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Marqeta is researching systems for embedding credit-based systems into non-credit-based systems, as described in 'Embedding credit-based systems in existing non-credit-based systems to generate.' Efforts also include real-time card transaction processing with cached balance inspection, computer transaction security with delegated decisions, and just-in-time funding of payment card accounts. Additional work covers cryptographic key lifecycle management, error detection in transaction databases, and blockchain-enabled payment transaction rerouting.

overview_description.description: Marqeta’s modern card issuing platform empowers its customers to create customized and innovative payment cards. Marqeta’s platform, powered by open APIs, gives its customers the ability to build more configurable and flexible payment experiences, accelerating product development and democratizing access to card-issuing technology. Its modern architecture provides instant access to highly scalable, cloud-based payment infrastructure that enables customers to launch and manage their own card programs, issue cards, and authorize and settle transactions. Marqeta is headquartered in Oakland, California, and is certified to operate in 40 countries globally.

about_short_description.short_description: Marqeta is a card issuing platform that provides infrastructure and tools to help companies build and manage payment programs.

product.name: Marqeta Card Issuing Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform for creating, issuing, managing, and processing debit, credit, prepaid, and virtual card programs.

product.name: Card Issuing and Processing
product.description: Services for issuing physical and virtual payment cards and processing card transactions, including card lifecycle and program management capabilities.

product.name: Program Management
product.description: Operational and technical services for launching, operating, and scaling card programs, including support for compliance, risk, issuing relationships, and card fulfillment.

product.name: Virtual Cards
product.description: A service for creating and issuing virtual payment cards for digital spending, supplier payments, expense management, and other embedded payment use cases.

product.name: Dynamic Spend Controls
product.description: Configurable controls for managing where, when, and how issued cards can be used, helping organizations enforce payment and expense policies.

product.name: Just-in-Time Funding
product.description: A funding capability that authorizes funds for card transactions at the time of purchase, supporting configurable and transaction-level payment flows.
